attempts.summary: On node1 (CentOS Stream 10, cronie), configured /etc/cron.allow to contain only root and opsadmin, restricting cron job scheduling to those two users. Created the opsadmin user since it did not previously exist. Verified via functional tests that root and opsadmin can install crontabs while other users are denied ("not allowed to use this program"). Performed the mandatory single-node restart of node1 (systemctl reboot), confirmed the boot_id changed (cce73776... -> 273bc930...), and re-verified post-restart that crond is active/enabled, /etc/cron.allow persisted, and the allow-list behavior still works correctly (opsadmin allowed, a fresh test user denied).
